meta.div_note: report2 uses div=16; DEFAULT_DIV=12 — direct backend honors div exactly, prefill backend needs rcs_sbr.DEFAULT_DIV monkeypatch (fork-inherited)
meta.el_note: NEGATIVE el only (belly view). Rows 0..-20 deg are the 2026-08-03 regenerated base; rows -24..-90 deg are the el-extension round. See el_rationale.
meta.quote_policy: percentiles/coverage only; NO null-min/sigma-min/aspect-peak/point value; m^2 linear mean (Jensen-optimistic, recorded)
meta.merge_note: deep-merge: 드론 키가 sigma.grid/stats 안쪽에 있어 최상위 update 로는 4종이 유실된다(2026-07-28 실제 발생, 백업으로 복구).
meta.el_rationale: New rows below -20 deg are placed from the MEASURED look-elevation density of the consumers (freespace_scene.look_el_deg over the published d x phi sweep, L=500 m, alt=60 and 120 m) and from a measured sigma(el) curvature probe (2.5 deg fine scan, outputs/partial/sigma_regen_0803/probe). Spacing widens from 4 deg near -24 deg, where 31 % of the out-of-range lookups sit, to 7 deg mid-range, then tightens to 3 deg below -78 deg where the nadir silhouette makes |dsigma/del| reach 4-10 dB per 2.5 deg. No positive el row: with the target above BOTH the 25 m illuminator mast and the 3 m receiver, the bisector z-component is negative identically, so look el is strictly negative (max observed -0.13 deg). Positive el appears only for target altitude below 25 m, which the report-13 scene never uses.

el_extension.worker: elx_worker.py (experiment_freespace_sigma._sigma_grid_one, div=16, jitter=2, penetrate=True, n_f=3, smooth 3 deg — identical convention to the base rows)

meta.source_note: base rows from the 2026-08-03 regeneration shards, NOT from the 2026-07-29 canonical file (mesh changed; cell-wise up to 26 dB)

convergence.method: production convention (120 az, n_f=3, 3 deg smoothing) recomputed at a finer ray grid and compared with the shipped div=16 row; the quoted number is the change in the azimuth LINEAR-MEAN level

meta.az_degenerate_note: At el = -90 deg the look vector is (0,0,-1) for every azimuth, so the row is one sigma replicated across az. That is correct monostatic physics, not a bug, but the row carries no azimuth averaging: if it lands in a null the whole row is a null. Do not quote per-azimuth statistics from it.
meta.multistatic_source: copied from canonical (computed at el=-2 deg)

anchor.statistic: azimuth LINEAR mean (10log10 mean sigma_m2) at el_ref, sigma_anchor.linear_mean_dbsm
anchor.relevel_crosscheck_note: conv_on branch must equal sigma_anchor.relevel() exactly; the production function is the oracle, not this replica
anchor.branch_note: The +2.5068 dB statistic-convention offset is a PURE LEVEL knob: it enters anchor_mu_dbsm as the same constant in every band. Under mode='slope_only' the production default it cancels EXACTLY (target = mu_anchor + (mean(mu_our) - mean(mu_anchor))), so both branches give bit-identical deltas. Under 'level_and_slope' it shifts every band by the same +2.5068 dB, i.e. it moves absolute R but cannot change which waveform wins. Report both branches anyway and lead with the slope, where it cancels.
